sites.name: M/V HONDIUS
sites.desc: Dutch-flagged polar vessel departed Cape Verde 06 May 19:15 local; 147 persons aboard (87 passengers, 60 crew) from 24 nationalities. Expected at Granadilla port, Tenerife early Sunday 10 May. Spain approved docking over Canary Islands president's objection. All aboard asymptomatic as of 08 May; one dead body still on board. Disembarkation window may close Tuesday due to deteriorating coastal weather.

sites.name: USHUAIA / ARGENTINA ROUTE
sites.desc: Confirmed source investigation zone. Argentine health ministry (06 May) detailed index case's 4-month road trip 27 Nov 2025–01 Apr 2026 spanning Chile, Uruguay, Argentina; returned from Uruguay only 4 days before boarding. Leading theory: couple exposed at a landfill during birdwatching tour in Ushuaia. Malbrán Institute conducting rodent capture along full route; no Argentina-linked outbreak cases identified.

sites.name: SAINT HELENA
sites.desc: 30 passengers disembarked 24 Apr before outbreak confirmed; index case body removed here. Case 2 (Dutch widow, PCR+) collapsed en route Johannesburg. Swiss confirmed case also disembarked here. Of 7 UK nationals: 2 self-isolating in UK, 4 remain on island, 1 traced outside UK. St Helena authorities monitoring higher-risk contacts.

sites.name: JOHANNESBURG
sites.desc: Case 2 (Dutch widow, PCR+) died on arrival 26 Apr. Case 3 (British expedition guide Martin Anstee, 56, PCR+) treated at Johannesburg ICU — condition improving; subsequently transferred to Netherlands. SA NICD contact-traced 65+ contacts from 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight (82 pax + 6 crew); 42 of 62 traced as of 07 May.

sites.name: AMSTERDAM / NIJMEGEN
sites.desc: Three evacuees (06 May medevac from Cape Verde) now in Dutch care: British Case 3 (56, confirmed) and Dutch crew member (41, confirmed) at Radboud UMC Nijmegen; 65-year-old German (asymptomatic contact) subsequently returned to Germany per WHO. KLM flight attendant tested NEGATIVE 08 May. GGD tracing KL592 passengers. One Dutch death (index case). Two Dutch medical specialists remain aboard Hondius.

sites.name: LONDON
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed 2 British nationals PCR+ (one in Netherlands, one treated South Africa). Two UK nationals who returned home independently self-isolating; both asymptomatic. UK government chartering plane to evacuate approximately 20 British nationals from Tenerife. FCDO/UKHSA Rapid Deployment Team pre-positioned at Tenerife. 45-day isolation protocol for returning Britons.

sites.name: PARIS
sites.desc: Eight French nationals identified as close contacts of confirmed case on 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight. One reporting mild symptoms, isolated pending PCR results. French health ministry coordinating diagnostics and quarantine measures.

sites.name: ZURICH
sites.desc: PCR-confirmed male passenger disembarked St Helena; self-presented to doctor after symptom onset, confirmed Andes virus at University Hospital Zurich. Wife (also on trip) asymptomatic and isolating. Swiss authorities conducting additional contact tracing.

sites.name: BERLIN
sites.desc: Third death: German woman died on board 02 May (fever/pneumonia onset 28 Apr) — cause of death under investigation, treated as suspected hantavirus. Asymptomatic 65-year-old German close contact evacuated 06 May to Netherlands has returned to Germany per WHO. RKI contact tracing active.

sites.name: ALICANTE
sites.desc: Woman hospitalized in negative-pressure isolation with cough and general malaise; seated on same 25 Apr St Helena–Johannesburg flight as Dutch deceased. PCR results pending per Spanish Secretary of State for Health Javier Padilla (08 May). Valencia Regional Health coordinating.

sites.name: TENERIFE
sites.desc: Ship arrival revised to early Sunday 10 May at Granadilla port. Spain's national government overrode Canary Islands president's veto; docking approved 'in accordance with international law.' Port workers held protests 08 May. Passengers to isolated, cordoned quayside then direct airport — zero contact with local population. Evacuation ops 11 May; window closes Tuesday due to worsening weather. WHO/CDC/UKHSA/ECDC/RIVM teams pre-positioned.

sites.name: TRISTAN DA CUNHA
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed suspected hantavirus case: British passenger (not local islander) who disembarked Hondius during 13–15 Apr stop; developed symptoms and sought medical advice before hospital testing confirmed Andes strain. Spouse isolating. UKHSA investigating; 4 islanders who traveled via Hondius to St Helena also being traced.

sites.name: SINGAPORE
sites.desc: Two male residents (aged 67 and 65) isolated in government facility; both disembarked Hondius at St Helena, flew via Johannesburg, returned 02–07 May. One presenting mild rhinorrhea, second asymptomatic. PCR test results pending. CDA: public risk in Singapore low.

sites.name: ONTARIO
sites.desc: Two Ontario residents self-isolating — Hondius passengers who returned home. Four Canadians total remain aboard vessel awaiting Tenerife evacuation. PHAC coordinating monitoring.

sites.name: QUEBEC
sites.desc: One Quebec resident self-isolating — not a Hondius passenger but shared homebound flight with two Canadian Hondius disembarkees. Asymptomatic; PHAC monitoring active.

sites.name: ARIZONA
sites.desc: ADHS monitoring one returning passenger under 42-day observation. Asymptomatic as of 08 May. Five US states collectively monitoring 7 disembarked passengers, all asymptomatic. CDC Level-3 response; CDC team dispatching to Tenerife to escort 17 Americans via charter to Nebraska NQU.

sites.name: CALIFORNIA
sites.desc: CDPH monitoring returning Hondius passenger(s). Asymptomatic as of 08 May. Daily check-in protocol active. 17 Americans still aboard ship to transit Tenerife to Nebraska quarantine via CDC-escorted State Dept charter.

sites.name: GEORGIA
sites.desc: Georgia DPH monitoring two residents who returned from Hondius. Both asymptomatic as of 08 May.

sites.name: TEXAS
sites.desc: Texas DSHS monitoring two returning Hondius passengers. Both asymptomatic. Part of 7-person US domestic monitoring cohort across 5 states.

sites.name: VIRGINIA
sites.desc: VDH monitoring one returning Hondius passenger. Asymptomatic. President Trump stated 08 May the US situation is 'very much, we hope, under control.'

sites.name: NEW JERSEY
sites.desc: NJ health authorities monitoring two individuals with potential post-disembarkation exposure to a Hondius passenger. Neither symptomatic as of 08 May.

sites.name: NEBRASKA
sites.desc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC National Quarantine Unit fully activated. CDC team deploying to Tenerife to escort 17 American Hondius passengers via charter flight to UNMC NQU. NQU is the only federally funded quarantine unit in the US; previously activated for Ebola and COVID-19.

sites.name: MANILA
sites.desc: 38 Filipino crew members aboard Hondius; Philippines DOH confirmed none are currently ill as of 08 May. In close coordination with vessel operator and international authorities. Monitoring continues pending Tenerife disembarkation.

sites.name: DUBLIN
sites.desc: Two Irish nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per RTE (08 May). Irish Dept of Health coordinating with ECDC and WHO; returning Irish nationals to quarantine in Ireland. Irish passengers included in ECDC TAB 06 May EU/EEA nationals briefing.

sites.name: PRAIA
sites.desc: Hondius anchored off Praia 03–06 May. Three medevac patients evacuated here 06 May before transfer to Netherlands. WHO Rep Ann Lindstrand on-site. Cape Verde assessed as unable to handle full passenger evacuation — basis for WHO requesting Tenerife. WHO diagnostic kits dispatched from Argentina; Cape Verde among recipient labs.
